title: A completion signature an agent cannot make on its own, and a way out of completing

AC1.note: runConfirm (src/commands/flow.ts) refuses non-TTY, wrong status, unfrozen/tampered AC and a wrong challenge; reads the challenge from /dev/tty; the store holds only the sha256, bound to flowId/kind/acChecksum (+target since 084380c9), with a 10-min TTL. src/flow/confirm-token.test.ts covers each refusal and that the plaintext token is in no flow file; 147/147 flow-299 tests pass at head 21c29e76; merge dbacee36 (#661).

AC2.note: gates.confirmation is stamped by flow init --require-confirmation or completion.require_confirmation; the confirmation gate fails with named reasons (token_required/not_minted/unreadable/mismatch/expired/used/other_flow/stale_criteria/target_mismatch) and returns the flow to in-progress with the attempt recorded. confirm-token.test.ts covers these; round-1 and round-2 probes P1/P2b/P3/P6 confirmed them; merge dbacee36 (#661).

AC3.note: consumeConfirmationToken runs only on the passing path, right before the done/signature save; the signature keeps identity and gains confirmation {mechanism terminal-token, tokenRef hash prefix, mintedAt, consumedAt, boundTo}; flow status, the complete note and the governance report render it; the basis enum is unchanged. Covered by confirm-token.test.ts AC3 cases and the schema tests; merge dbacee36 (#661).

AC4.note: No MCP or agent tool mints (confirm-floors.test.ts pins the callers); touchesHumanConfirmation forces ask in agent.ts, acp-permission.ts and supervise-mcp.ts, and since 084380c9 also in the REPL/TUI approver (shell-approval.ts:74, shell-permissions.ts:144/411/477). The unattended floor refuses flow confirm/recover and confirm-token.json. Review 2026-09-23-review-299 F-001/F-003 refuted on merge dbacee36 (#661).

AC5.note: Every throwing gate is caught; the failure path uses returnToInProgress; a late tamper records a second failed attempt with no signature and no spend. src/flow/completion-never-stuck.test.ts reproduces all three and asserts status in-progress, the attempt recorded and no complete signature; merge dbacee36 (#661).

AC6.note: flow recover refuses without --reason, from any non-completing status, and while the lock is held; it appends completion-recovered with the reason, last event and AC state; signatures and attempts are untouched. Two-process probe confirmed the live-lock refusal and recovery after the lock goes stale; flow status and the TUI /flows show 'interrupted' (flow-inspector-interrupted.test.ts); merge dbacee36 (#661).

AC7.note: confirmation-backward-compat.test.ts sweeps .metaproject/flows/*/flow.json and a pre-change fixture: they load, validate and pass flow check; a flow without gates.confirmation reports the gate skipped with an unchanged outcome; no schemaVersion bump. TM-03 section 8 notes that older keryx flags the new gate name (F-006); merge dbacee36 (#661).

AC8.note: TM-03 (linked from TM-02 section 7) and the CLI reference state the caveat and name all the bypasses and the delegation; since 21c29e76 also that --merged binds no commit (TM-03:29, cli-reference.md:2116); SAC confirm-review has the same limits. confirmation-docs.test.ts greps them; CONFIRMATION_CAVEAT is printed by flow complete; merge dbacee36 (#661).

AC9.note: CI on PR #661 at head 21c29e76: 19 check runs, 18 success and 1 skipped (gh api check-runs). keryx health run on the branch: PASS, score 94, no gate conditions triggered. Squash-merged as dbacee36c553946b1026a33956ade21f5f2e2a39.
